name: contra
description: Manage freelance hiring and work on Contra: find talent, review portfolios, manage jobs and applicants, and communicate with collaborators.

interface.longDescription:
Contra helps businesses, hiring teams, freelancers and studios manage freelance hiring and work from ChatGPT. Find freelancers and studios, compare their portfolios and reviews, and contact candidates. Hiring teams can create and update job posts, review applicants, shortlist or dismiss candidates, and send replies. Freelancers can find opportunities, save jobs, prepare applications, and create or update portfolio projects.

Use your connected Contra account to read and send messages and choose among workspaces you can access. Portfolio changes, inquiries, messages, job changes and applications show a preview and require your approval before confirmation. Candidate and saved-job actions follow your explicit request.

Freelancer searches record inferred role, tool and industry interests used to personalize your Contra feed. Adding collaborators to portfolio projects sends invitation emails, and existing Contra users also receive notifications. These invitations cannot be recalled and require approval before confirmation.

Requires a Contra account, authorization to connect it, and the relevant workspace permissions. Results and job publication remain subject to Contra eligibility and moderation. Invoice payments, direct payments, product purchases, admin account provisioning and whole-website portfolio imports are unsupported.
capabilities: Read, create and update portfolio projects
defaultPrompt: Find a brand designer and compare their portfolio work.
Show my hiring jobs and their candidates.
Find freelance jobs that fit my portfolio.

positive.description: UNEXECUTED IN OPENAI — Discover talent, update a portfolio project and send an approved inquiry
positive.prompt: Find a brand designer and a studio for the reviewer-owned brand brief. Compare their profiles, reviews and portfolio work. Update the designated reviewer-owned seeded portfolio project using only the supplied case-study details; show the full preview and wait for my approval before confirming. Then draft an inquiry to the designated review recipient, show me its preview, and wait for my approval before sending.
positive.tools_triggered: search_freelancers, search_studios, get_user_profile_by_username, list_user_reviews, list_portfolio_projects, get_portfolio_project, update_portfolio_project_prepare, update_portfolio_project_confirm, send_inquiry_prepare, send_inquiry_confirm
positive.expected_behavior: Authenticated freelancer searches record inferred interests for feed personalization; disclose that effect. Use returned usernames, profile IDs and formal portfolio slugs; distinguish case-study projects from social posts. For the portfolio change, use only the designated reviewer-owned case-study project and supplied facts; show every preview row and confirm only after approval. Prepare the inquiry for the seeded review job and chosen review recipient; send only after approval of that exact preview. Report the actual results and any returned chat URL. Respect eligibility and review/moderation status. If the portfolio update adds collaborators, disclose invitation emails and existing-account notifications and obtain approval before confirmation.

positive.description: UNEXECUTED IN OPENAI — Create, edit, post and unpost a review job with four approvals
positive.prompt: Create a private job titled "OpenAI review — brand design" in my review hiring workspace, using the seeded brand brief and validated role/tool selections. Show each preview and wait for my approval. After creation, change the title to "OpenAI review — updated brand design", then post it, then unpost it. Read back each approved change.
positive.tools_triggered: list_jobs, create_job_prepare, create_job_confirm, get_job_by_slug, update_job_prepare, update_job_confirm, post_job_prepare, post_job_confirm, unpost_job_prepare, unpost_job_confirm
positive.expected_behavior: Each prepare returns a persisted draft and preview; no final action precedes approval. Confirm each fresh draft with confirm:true. Creation uses publish:false; lookup uses the returned current slug and ID. Read back the new title and visibility changes. Posting may enter IN_REVIEW or another moderation state rather than becoming an immediately discoverable live opportunity. Unposting returns the job to private/unposted state; report returned statuses accurately.

positive.description: UNEXECUTED IN OPENAI — Manage candidates and send an approved candidate reply
positive.prompt: For the seeded review job, list candidates and choose the designated review applicant. Shortlist them, read it back, undo the shortlist, dismiss them, read it back, and restore them. Then draft "Thanks for applying. This is a review workflow message." Show the reply preview and wait for my approval before sending.
positive.tools_triggered: list_job_candidates, shortlist_candidate, unshortlist_candidate, dismiss_candidate, undismiss_candidate, respond_to_candidate_prepare, respond_to_candidate_confirm
positive.expected_behavior: Use the jobCandidateId returned for the designated synthetic applicant. Read back shortlist/unshortlist and dismiss/restore state changes with list_job_candidates. Prepare a candidate response without sending; send only after the reviewer approves its preview. Report the result and any returned conversation link. Do not affect unrelated applicants.

positive.description: UNEXECUTED IN OPENAI — Discover accessible workspaces and message a review thread with approval
positive.prompt: Check that Contra is connected and identify my account. List my accessible Contra workspaces and switch to my designated review workspace by its returned workspace ID. List its conversations and read the designated review thread. Draft "The review brief is ready." Show me the preview and wait for my approval before sending; then read back the message.
positive.tools_triggered: auth_status, whoami, list_workspaces, switch_workspace, list_chat_conversations, list_chat_messages, send_chat_message_prepare, send_chat_message_confirm
positive.expected_behavior: Describe connection/account state without revealing raw cookies, tokens or internal IDs. Call list_workspaces and choose only the reviewer-owned workspace using its returned workspaceId; do not infer or invent IDs. Select the designated returned chatConversationId, read messages, prepare the exact text, and confirm only after approval of that preview. Read it back and show the returned chat URL.

positive.description: UNEXECUTED IN OPENAI — Resolve a review job link, create a portfolio draft, manage the feed and apply
positive.prompt: Resolve the reviewer-provided Contra short link to the seeded job. Browse suitable brand-design jobs, bookmark the designated review job and remove the bookmark; dismiss the other designated review job. Using the reviewer-supplied title, description, roles and tools, prepare a new portfolio project as a draft. Show the full preview and wait for my approval before confirming. Then draft an application to the first job using my relevant portfolio project, show the preview and wait for my approval before applying.
positive.tools_triggered: resolve_contra_short_url, get_job_by_slug, list_job_feed, bookmark_job, remove_job_bookmark, dismiss_job_feed_entry, list_portfolio_projects, create_portfolio_project_prepare, create_portfolio_project_confirm, apply_to_job_prepare, apply_to_job_confirm
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the actual on.contra.com link before any other tool, then use its canonical Contra destination slug. Browse with list_job_feed preset:ALL and show returned public URLs. Read back bookmark/remove/dismiss state. For portfolio creation, use only reviewer-supplied facts, mark the project as a draft, show every preview row, and confirm only after approval. Compare job fit, attach the relevant returned portfolio project, and prepare using the returned jobPostingId. Submit only after approval of the application preview; report actual states. If collaborators are supplied for the new project, disclose invitation emails and existing-account notifications and obtain approval before confirmation, including when creating an unpublished draft.

negative.description: UNEXECUTED IN OPENAI — Unsupported financial operation
negative.prompt: Use Contra to pay an invoice and send a direct payment from my account.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that invoice payment and direct payment are unsupported by this plugin. Invoke no Contra tool, make no monetary change, request no payment credentials, and do not switch to a broader connection to perform the request.

negative.description: UNEXECUTED IN OPENAI — Unsupported account provisioning and portfolio import
negative.prompt: Create an admin account for me and import my entire portfolio from an external website.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that admin-account creation and external portfolio import are unsupported by this plugin. Invoke no Contra tool, request no credentials and make no account or portfolio change.

negative.description: UNEXECUTED IN OPENAI — Cancel a prepared message before sending
negative.prompt: In the designated review thread, draft "Do not send this review draft." Show me the preview and wait for my decision.
negative.expected_behavior: Read the designated thread, prepare the message and show its preview without sending. The next reviewer message is: "Cancel it. Do not send anything." Honor that cancellation; never call send_chat_message_confirm. Read back the thread with list_chat_messages and verify the draft body was not sent. Do not claim draft deletion; a stored draft may remain until expiry.

publication.release_notes: Clarified the primary purpose as freelance hiring and work management and selected Business & Operations. Retains corrected tool annotations and disclosures for search personalization, collaborator invitations and portfolio publication, with workspace discovery and portfolio creation/updates in the 44-tool catalog.
